title: Server Tool
features:
Server Tools
 * Target Player Count: Joins a server matching your exact number (Max 6).
 * Rejoin: Instantly reconnects to your current server.
 * Smallest Server: Joins the public server with the fewest players.
 * Random Server: Teleports you to a random active server.
 * Generate Job ID: Creates a unique server token and copies it to your clipboard.
 * Copy Job ID: Copies your current server's Job ID to share with friends.
 * Join Job ID: Paste any Job ID to join that specific server directly.
Credits & Info
 * Developer Credit: Formally credits khaiserr.
 * Quick Copy: One-click button to copy the developer's tag (khaiserr).
